limitations.issue: All five admitted lifecycle dispositions are UNRESOLVED and none were promoted to world.sqlite because the active role is BOOLEAN. Derivation applies mechanical inactive detection only for contracts with explicit expiry_date in contract_term; other lifecycle uncertainty is non-blocking for inclusion.
Purpose-scoped clause_kind_judgment tuples are not persisted in world.sqlite. Derivation reads ACCEPT/REJECT/UNRESOLVED dispositions from 05_dispositions.json.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter on recorded billing status; no epistemic dispositions.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is invoice_record; COMPLETE when every invoice with status='open' is emitted.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record.status is authoritative for open/closed billing state.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emits directed left/right identifier pairs only; does not assert identity disposition.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is the commercial-cluster reconciliation graph: each CRM account, its invoice billed-name identifier, governing contract identifier, and registry rows that are candidate legal entities for that relationship.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Materialize required directed edges from account_record, invoice_record, contract_record, and entity_record without asserting disposition.
derivations.required_premise: Cluster membership is fixed by mechanical compilation (shared primary name token and CRM account-id prefix mapping).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Join reconciliation_link to identity_judgment on (left, right); map disposition to epistemic field (SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, UNRESOLVED). Missing judgment is not treated as DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every reconciliation_link row must have a matching identity_judgment tuple.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT rl.left, rl.right, ij.disposition FROM reconciliation_link rl JOIN identity_judgment ij ON rl.left = ij.left AND rl.right = ij.right ORDER BY rl.left, rl.right
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment provides epistemic disposition for each required reconciliation edge.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Emit link with epistemic UNRESOLVED; does not suppress the edge.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Include invoice when its candidate contract is not known inactive and has at least one acquisition-relevant clause_kind_judgment ACCEPT. Map billing-to-contract identity SAME_ENTITY to association asserted and UNRESOLVED to association unresolved. DISTINCT or absent billing-to-contract judgment suppresses the row.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row universe is invoices whose billed_name links to a contract with acquisition-relevant ACCEPT clause and is not mechanically inactive. Qualifying invoices are not suppressed solely because identity linkage is uncertain.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each invoice_record, resolve billing:{billed_name} to contract via identity_judgment; require ACCEPT acquisition clause_kind from 05_dispositions; exclude contracts with explicit expiry_date in contract_term (expired SoW); emit invoice attributes with association disposition.
required_premise: At least one clause_kind_judgment ACCEPT for an allowed acquisition kind on the candidate contract.
Candidate contract is not mechanically inactive (explicit expiry_date in contract_term).
optional_enrichment: contract_lifecycle_judgment with active=true would strengthen active-contract premise but is not required when lifecycle is UNRESOLVED and contract is not mechanically inactive.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Suppress row; billed name and contract counterparty are confidently not the same party.
Treat contract as inactive; suppress invoice rows for that contract (expired statement of work).

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Emit invoice with association unresolved when other inclusion premises hold.
Does not block inclusion when contract is not mechanically inactive; missing active judgment is not treated as inactive.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Per contract, status dependent only when current-relationship evidence and qualifying obligation_kinds are both confidently satisfied and required identity joins are SAME_ENTITY. Any required UNRESOLVED identity or missing obligation evidence yields status unresolved; never emit false non-dependency from uncertain joins.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit a row for each contract that has open-invoice current-relationship evidence or a qualifying obligation ACCEPT, when dependency must be reported as dependent or left unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each contract with open_invoice-linked billed_name or ACCEPT obligation kind (exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term), evaluate current-relationship (open invoice with SAME_ENTITY billing-to-contract join, or active contract with rolling/auto-renew term when lifecycle known active) and obligation_kinds from clause_kind_judgment ACCEPT; aggregate open_invoice_ids; set status dependent or unresolved.
required_premise: Contract is a candidate via open_invoice-linked billing identity path or ACCEPT obligation kind.
For status dependent: billing-to-contract identity_judgment is SAME_ENTITY, at least one obligation_kind ACCEPT, and current-relationship evidence (open invoice on SAME_ENTITY join).
optional_enrichment: contract_lifecycle_judgment active=true for current-relationship via auto-renewal or rolling term without open invoice.
contract_term stated_term text for mechanical rolling/auto-renew detection when lifecycle is UNRESOLVED.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Force status unresolved when open invoice or obligation evidence otherwise suggests dependency.
Cannot assert dependent; omit or leave unresolved if other evidence exists.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Does not block dependent status when open_invoice provides current-relationship evidence.
Treat as no qualifying obligation; does not assert dependent without ACCEPT.
